diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says WDIR, datasheet reading says Pin 1
diffs.evidence: Same conductor with a different label: the WDIR pin of the part is RJ11 pin 1, an outer conductor of the shared cable, and the datasheet gives only the inner pair to the anemometer ('The anemometer switch is connected to the inner two conductors of the RJ 11 cable shared by the anemometer and wind vane(pins 2 and 3)'), so the vane network is on outer pins 1 and 4, which the second reading also lists, with no pin names.

diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says GND, datasheet reading says Pin 4
diffs.evidence: Same conductor with a different label: the second header pin of the part (GND) is RJ11 pin 4, the other outer conductor, since the anemometer uses the inner pair ('You can measure this on the two inner conductors of the RJ11 connector (pins 2 and 3)'); the passive resistor network has no polarity, so grounding this end is just the wiring convention.
